title: Snake
line: Snake, the first game: the mrly marks play food, head and body. A saver when it plays itself.

title: SFX
line: SFX, the sounds of the voyage: synthesised in the browser from a seed, each one to play and to save as a WAV.

title: Techno
line: Techno, an acid loop grown from a seed on a 16-step grid, synthesised in the browser, to play and to save as a WAV.

title: Zoom
line: Zoom, an endless flight into any 3D mrlybang code: 255 shapes, each flown its own way, corridor, trench, pillars or skim, and each a lesson in self-similarity.

title: Planets
line: Planets, worlds lit as a camera sees them: oceans that glint, clouds that cast shadows, city lights, rings and moons, grown in the browser from a seed.

title: Voyage
line: Voyage, a short film grown from a seed: leave a world, jump to lightspeed, fly the corridors of your own ship and come out at another world. A saver that plays itself.

title: Spirograph
line: Spirograph, a design as the wheel: a pencil in every cell rides it along a line, a circle or a polygon, and every pencil draws its own curve.

title: Font
line: Font, the pens of MrlyFont: type a text and watch it write itself cell by cell, then fold into one stack; every glyph in a gallery with its strokes and its floor; export the animation as JSON, SVG or video.

title: Life
line: Life, the game of life on any design: seed a soup, a design, a glider or one cell, set the births and the stays by digits or by a named sequence on a mrly mask, watch it evolve and paint it; the 256 elementary rules as the 256 cube designs.

title: Sequences
line: Sequences, the mrly OEIS: every count a design writes, level by level or side by side, as integer sequences to search, chart side by side, match against the records and export.

title: Designs
line: Designs, the gallery of every mrlybang code: a plane or a cube, base 2 or 3, each design grown on the stage with its class, its orbit and its counts read out, to keep as a still.

title: Two
line: Two, one 2D design repeated into a sheet and cropped to a circle, a diamond or a triangle, inverted and tinted at will, with its counts read out, to save as a PNG at any size or as an SVG.

title: Spin
line: Spin, a design on a turntable strobed by the screen: at the right rpm it freezes or drifts backwards, spun infinitely fast every pixel is the mean on its circle, the exact wheel, and its turned copies stack into a rosette.

title: Three
line: Three, one 3D design grown from a code: orbit the sponge in the tint, crop it to a ball or a box, cut it along an axis, down the diagonal or through its central hexagon, and keep it as a picture, a video or an OBJ.

title: Six
line: Six, a 3D design on the triangular lattice: the cube seen isometric, face on or cut through its middle, as one hexagon or a disc of them, its triangles, pieces and holes counted; PNG and a tileable SVG out.

title: Stack
line: Stack, one design sampled at the odd scales and layered into one field: the moire with its interference, the tourbillon that turns every layer by its own angle and spins it, and the ghost star in the stacked cuts of the carpet cube.

title: Snail
line: Snail, the whole numbers wound on the square spiral, each one a design tile whose side grows with its digits, so the path curls outward like a shell: the primes alone or every number, laid tile by tile with the camera pulling back.

title: Gaussian
line: Gaussian, the primes of the plane: give the whole numbers i and a four-armed snowflake of primes grows from the origin norm by norm, six arms on the hexagonal lattice, each ordinary prime split, inert or ramified; tap a point for its norm, its fate and its factors.

title: Race
line: Race, random walkers released on two designs: each board a heat of trails in its own shade, a ring at the swarm's reach, first to the goal wins; type two codes or let the seed pick a pair of equal mass, and see which design has the open corridors.

title: Ulam
line: Ulam, the whole numbers wound in a spiral from one and the primes lit: diagonals appear on their own, each one a quadratic rich in primes; light a line, tap a number for its factors, or wind the same numbers on hexagons and watch the lines bend.

title: Apollonian
line: Apollonian, a packing of tangent circles grown in exact integers from a root quadruple and filling in one octave of curvature a second; on the strip the circles resting on the line are the Ford circles, lit apart with a tick at each tangency, and Depth lays the Farey stack beneath them; a tap reads a circle's triple.

title: Zeta
line: Zeta, the critical line walked: put s = 1/2 + it, let t grow, and the point loops round the plane, straight through the origin at every zero, a ring and a count at each pass; start anywhere up to ten thousand, or turn to the stairs and fold the zeros one by one into the staircase of the primes; keep the picture and the zeros as a list.

title: Arcs
line: Arcs, every cell of a design carrying two quarter circles that join into curves: the strands run border to border, always twice the side, the loops close on themselves in a count the design decides, lit one by one as a pen wanders round them, with the proved law where there is one; PNG, SVG or video out.

title: Morse
line: Morse, the Thue-Morse word as a mrly object: the word grown by substitution, lifted to the plane four ways and grown a Kronecker power at a time, and any design read plus-minus beside its own fold or filtered against its next level, with the runs and the faults counted.

title: Graphs
line: Graphs, a design as a network: join every filled cell to its neighbours, the corners and sides they outline, or the empty cells between them, then count the tips, the junctions and the pieces, add up the length and read the box dimension; drawn on its lattice as the wave of a search reveals it, relaxed by a force layout, or orbited as a cube.

title: Radix
line: Radix, a design's digits placed by a base of the plane: the twindragon at 1 + i, the terdragon at 2 + w, the flowsnake at 3 + w, the Koch curve at 3, the gasket at 2, or any 3 by 3 tile at the whole base 3, grown a level at a time with the fill, the distinct points and the dimension read out.
